OpenMx Matrices of a Diagonal Covariance Matrix

Source: R/mxHelper-sigma-diag-from-ldl-mx-matrix.R
MxHelperSigmaDiagFromLDLMxMatrix.Rd

Builds a diagonal covariance matrix whose diagonal is the softplus of an unconstrained column vector: the column vector (column_name), the algebra (name), its half-vectorization (<name>_vech), and a column vector of the free elements (<name>_vec). With d_equal = TRUE, the free diagonal elements are equal. The arguments are checked first; the internal version, without checks, is the one other projects copy.

Usage

MxHelperSigmaDiagFromLDLMxMatrix(
  p,
  name,
  column_name,
  d_free,
  d_values,
  d_lbound,
  d_ubound,
  d_rows,
  d_cols,
  d_equal
)

Arguments

p

Positive integer. Number of rows and columns of the square matrix.

name

Character string. Name of the matrix or algebra.

column_name

Character string. Name of the column vector of unconstrained diagonal elements of \(\boldsymbol{D}\).

d_free

Logical vector or NULL. Which diagonal elements are free. NULL means all.

d_values

Numeric vector, matrix, or NULL. Starting values of the unconstrained diagonal elements: a vector of length p, a p by 1 matrix, or a p by p matrix whose diagonal is used. If NULL, the inverse softplus of 1.

d_lbound

Numeric vector or NULL. Lower bounds of the unconstrained diagonal elements.

d_ubound

Numeric vector or NULL. Upper bounds of the unconstrained diagonal elements.

d_rows

Character vector or NULL. Row names of the column vector.

d_cols

Character vector or NULL. Column name of the column vector.

d_equal

Logical. If TRUE, the free diagonal elements share one label (<column_name>_eq), so they are equal.

Value

Returns a named list of OpenMx matrices and algebras.

See also

Other Covariance Matrix Functions: MxHelperInvLDL(), MxHelperInvSoftplus(), MxHelperLDL(), MxHelperSigmaDiagFromLDLSoftplusAlgebra(), MxHelperSigmaFixed(), MxHelperSigmaFromLDLFixed(), MxHelperSigmaFromLDLLogAlgebra(), MxHelperSigmaFromLDLMxMatrix(), MxHelperSigmaFromLDLSoftplusAlgebra(), MxHelperSoftplus()

Author

Ivan Jacob Agaloos Pesigan

Examples

MxHelperSigmaDiagFromLDLMxMatrix(
  p = 2,
  name = "sigma",
  column_name = "sigma_d",
  d_free = TRUE,
  d_values = NULL,
  d_lbound = NA,
  d_ubound = NA,
  d_rows = NULL,
  d_cols = NULL,
  d_equal = FALSE
)
#> $sigma_d
#> FullMatrix 'sigma_d' 
#> 
#> $labels
#>     j_1          
#> i_1 "sigma_d_1_1"
#> i_2 "sigma_d_2_1"
#> 
#> $values
#>           j_1
#> i_1 0.5413249
#> i_2 0.5413249
#> 
#> $free
#>      j_1
#> i_1 TRUE
#> i_2 TRUE
#> 
#> $lbound: No lower bounds assigned.
#> 
#> $ubound: No upper bounds assigned.
#> 
#> 
#> $sigma_d_vec
#> FullMatrix 'sigma_d_vec' 
#> 
#> $labels
#>              sigma_d_vec   
#> sigma_d[1,1] "sigma_d[1,1]"
#> sigma_d[2,1] "sigma_d[2,1]"
#> 
#> $values
#>              sigma_d_vec
#> sigma_d[1,1]           0
#> sigma_d[2,1]           0
#> 
#> $free: No free parameters.
#> 
#> $lbound: No lower bounds assigned.
#> 
#> $ubound: No upper bounds assigned.
#> 
#> 
#> $sigma
#> mxAlgebra 'sigma' 
#> $formula:  vec2diag(((sigma_d + abs(sigma_d))/2) + mxRobustLog(1 + exp(-abs(sigma_d))) + 1e-08) 
#> $result: (not yet computed) <0 x 0 matrix>
#> dimnames: NULL
#> 
#> $sigma_vech
#> mxAlgebra 'sigma_vech' 
#> $formula:  vech(sigma) 
#> $result: (not yet computed) <0 x 0 matrix>
#> dimnames: NULL
#> 
#> $sigma_vec
#> FullMatrix 'sigma_vec' 
#> 
#> $labels
#>            sigma_vec   
#> sigma[1,1] "sigma[1,1]"
#> sigma[2,2] "sigma[2,2]"
#> 
#> $values
#>            sigma_vec
#> sigma[1,1]         0
#> sigma[2,2]         0
#> 
#> $free: No free parameters.
#> 
#> $lbound: No lower bounds assigned.
#>
